title: Month 19
subtitle: Two words together is the next milestone, and it is closer than it looks.

baby.development: Your child says around twenty words and is starting to put two together, like more milk or daddy gone. They can run, kick a ball, and climb onto a chair.

you.body: If you are carrying a nineteen-month-old, your shoulder is doing the work your back used to. Switch sides and use the stroller for the long walks.
you.mind: Nineteen months is when the child starts to negotiate. It is a good sign, and it is the reason a choice between two things works better than an instruction.

coreActions.title: Model two words together
coreActions.why: Two-word phrases are the next language step, and they come from hearing them rather than from being asked to repeat them.
coreActions.detail: When the child says one word, give it back with two: milk becomes more milk, up becomes up please. Do not correct, just expand. Most children put two words together between eighteen and twenty-four months.

coreActions.title: Decide the screen rule now, before it is a fight
coreActions.why: A rule set at nineteen months is easier to hold than a rule set at three, when the child can argue.
coreActions.detail: For a child under two, the recommendation is no solo screen time other than video calls. If you use a screen, watch it together and talk about it. Background television is the thing to turn off, because it costs language even when nobody is watching.

coreActions.title: Brush twice a day, and finish the job yourself
coreActions.why: A toddler can hold a brush but cannot clean the back teeth, and the habit is what carries into the years when they can.
coreActions.detail: A pea-sized amount of fluoride toothpaste, twice a day. Let them have a turn, then take it and finish. Lying down or standing behind works better than facing them. A two-minute song is a better timer than a threat.

alsoKnow.title: Picky eating is a stage, not a verdict
alsoKnow.body: Appetite drops in the second year because growth slows. Keep offering the food without pressure, eat together, and do not make a second meal. A child may need to see a food fifteen times before eating it.

alsoKnow.title: Iron is the nutrient to watch
alsoKnow.body: Milk displaces iron-rich food. Keep milk to about sixteen ounces a day, and offer meat, beans, lentils, and fortified cereal. Low iron shows up as tiredness and irritability, not as a symptom you would notice.

redFlags.text: Choking — cannot breathe, cough, or make a sound
A fever over 100.4°F with unusual sleepiness or a rash
A fall from furniture, or a head injury with vomiting or unusual sleepiness
